findings.title: Omission of secret masking on history read command views
findings.requirement_ref: phase-100368 §7 (Security Constraints - Required Controls & Sensitive Data Rules), AC-100368-04, NFR-6
findings.recommendation: In `HistoryGroup::decorate` (`crates/clio-lib/src/cli_read_history.rs`), invoke `clio_config::secret::mask_value("", payload)` so that any credential or secret material embedded within task records, definitions, failure lessons, or temporal records is masked in CLI output per §7.

findings.title: Missing tool binding arrow for `graph query` in top-level `print_help()`
findings.recommendation: Update `crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:401` in `print_help()` to append `-> graph_query`, matching the formatting of all other 19 CLI read command entries.

findings.title: Developer execution round attribution row omitted from phase file Attribution table
findings.recommendation: Update the Attribution table in § Attribution of the phase file to record the Developer execution agent row.

plan_1hr: In `crates/clio-lib/src/cli_read_history.rs:82`, invoke `clio_config::secret::mask_value("", payload)` inside `HistoryGroup::decorate` so all history payloads are sanitized against secret leakage.
In `crates/clio-lib/src/main.rs:401`, append `-> graph_query` to the `clio graph query` line in `print_help()`.
In `crates/clio-lib/src/cli_read_history_tests.rs`, add a test asserting that a planted secret in a task definition or failure lesson is masked by `task get` / `task history` / `failure list`.
In `roadmap/phase-100368-full-cli-history-graph-reads.md`, ensure the Attribution table accurately reflects all developer rounds.
Re-run `make check` and `make coverage` to confirm all tests pass and coverage remains >=90% per-file.
plan_unlimited: Implement a centralized masking pass in `cli_read::run_parsed` so that any read command (current or future) automatically benefits from defense-in-depth secret masking without relying on each `ReadGroup` to remember calling `clio_config::secret::mask_value` in `decorate`.

Enhance the human text renderer for `persona get` (`render_persona`) to optionally render key names or preview entries instead of only returning counts (`stable: N, preferences: M`), improving UX for terminal users.
Ensure automated tests verify that every command listed in `command_bindings()` has an exact corresponding line in `print_help()` with the `-> <tool>` pattern, preventing formatting drift.
